monitor.request:
select jen.JOB_INSTANCE_ID\, jen.JOB_EXECUTION_ID\, jen.STATUS\, jen.EXIT_CODE\, jps.STRING_VAL APPLICATION\, jps1.STRING_VAL REFERENCE\, jps2.STRING_VAL TYPE
from TBJB_JOB_EXECUTION jen\, TBJB_JOB_PARAMS jps\, TBJB_JOB_PARAMS jps1\, TBJB_JOB_PARAMS jps2
where jps.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = jen.JOB_INSTANCE_ID and jps.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = jps1.JOB_INSTANCE_ID and jps.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = jps2.JOB_INSTANCE_ID
and jps.KEY_NAME NOT LIKE jps1.KEY_NAME and jps1.KEY_NAME NOT LIKE jps2.KEY_NAME and jps.KEY_NAME NOT LIKE jps2.KEY_NAME and jps.KEY_NAME = 'Application' and jps1.KEY_NAME = 'RefBatch' and jps2.KEY_NAME = 'Type'
and jen.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = ( select max(jen2.JOB_EXECUTION_ID) from TBJB_JOB_EXECUTION jen2 where jen2.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = jen.JOB_INSTANCE_ID ) order by jen.JOB_INSTANCE_ID DESC
